newsitem.title: IRAQ: U.S. ceasefire holds throughout northern Iraq.
newsitem.headline: U.S. ceasefire holds throughout northern Iraq.

text.p: A U.S.-brokered ceasefire took hold throughout northern Iraq on Friday, a day after clashes between Kurdish factions had marred the truce, Iraqi Kurdish officials said.

"There were some clashes until about nine o'clock last night (1700 GMT) but the ceasefire is now fully in position," Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) commander Roj Nuri Shuwayis told Reuters in the frontline town of Degala.
U.S. ceasefire holds throughout northern Iraq

There were no reports of fighting from the rest of the mountainous region. The KDP and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) exchanged fire near Degala on Thursday despite the ceasefire being called for the night before.
Delegations from the two sides are to meet in Turkey next week for peace talks chaired by a senior U.S. diplomat, the State Department said.
Fighters on both sides of the frontline pitched tents in the rain on Friday and gathered in small groups smoking and chatting.
The clashes, which began in August, had threatened to draw in Iran and Iraq.
